# Local Android MCP

Local-only, model-agnostic Android control over ADB through MCP. The AI client
provides reasoning; this package exposes a constrained tool surface and makes no
cloud or model calls.

Primary documentation:
- README.md
- AGENTS.md
- docs/AI-INTEGRATION.md
- docs/CLIENT-COMPATIBILITY.md
- docs/INSTALL-MAC-WINDOWS.md
- docs/local-android.manifest.json

Core implementation:
- src/server.ts: MCP tools and schemas
- src/adb.ts: safe ADB execution
- src/installer.ts: portable multi-client installation
- src/cli.ts: detection, setup, doctor, uninstall
- src/config.ts: portable persisted device selection
- src/emulator.ts: safe Android Virtual Device inventory/start
- src/ui.ts: localhost-only device selector

Bootstrap:
1. npm install
2. npm run install:global
3. local-android-mcp detect
4. local-android-mcp setup
5. local-android-mcp setup --yes --force
6. local-android-mcp doctor
7. local-android-mcp ui

Never instruct an agent to add arbitrary adb shell execution. Use only the
documented MCP tools and preserve the safety constraints in AGENTS.md.
